history: Record initial local and remote heads, approval, hooks, merge decisions, attempted effects and read-back. Each retry starts from fresh remote observation; preserve rejected attempts and never repeat an uncertain push.

items.expect: Merge, push and tag effects have known outcomes.

onFail.instruction: Fetch local and remote refs first; never repeat a push or tag whose completion is uncertain.

stopWhen: Stop after two feedback rounds, recurring hook or ancestry failure, changed remote, missing approval, unavailable capability or uncertain unobservable effect. Never force, rebase, bypass hooks or duplicate publication effects.
